commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
90+1' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Chimy Avila (Betis) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Betis.
89' Chimy Avila (Betis) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

89' Natan (Betis) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the left post. Wojciech Szczesny pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed. Betis have a corner.
87' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sees a yellow card from Jesus Manzano after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
85' Gerard Martin (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' One of the players from Betis times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
83' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) heads on.
81' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
81' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
80' Raphinha (Barcelona) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but his low effort is straight at Adrian.
80' Aitor Ruibal (Betis) trips an opposition player and Jesus Manzano signals a foul. Barcelona are awarded the free kick.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Johnny Cardoso departs the field of play to be replaced by Diego Llorente (Betis).
77' Jesus Manzano shows a yellow card to Eric Garcia (Barcelona) for a tough tackle.
77' Looks like Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.

76' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Raphinha (Barcelona), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Fermin Lopez (Barcelona) is replacing Pedri.
75' It is time for a substitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is on for Cucho Hernandez.
75' Here is a change. Alejandro Balde is going off and Hansi Flick gives the last tactical orders to Gerard Martin (Barcelona).
75' Today's match ends for Antony who will be replaced by Jesus Rodriguez (Betis).
74' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
72' Eric Garcia (Barcelona) is caught offside!
71' Pedri (Barcelona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
71' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Adrian comes off his line to intercept.
68' The ball is cleared after Aitor Ruibal (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball goes out of play and Barcelona will have a goal kick.

67' What a chance that is! Raphinha (Barcelona) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
66' Raphinha (Barcelona) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
66' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
65' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul after Gavi (Barcelona) hacks down one of his opponents.
65' Pedri (Barcelona) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
65' Raphinha (Barcelona) takes the corner kick, but Adrian reads it well and stops the effort.
63' Pedri (Barcelona) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

62' Gavi (Barcelona) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Barcelona have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is penalised for holding. Jesus Manzano signals a set piece.
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and William Carvalho (Betis) comes onto the pitch for Giovani Lo Celso.
57' Hansi Flick has decided to substitute Ferran Torres and he is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Eric Garcia (Barcelona) comes onto the pitch so that Frenkie de Jong can be given a rest.
56' Pedri (Barcelona) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Adrian has no trouble gathering it.
56' The attendance for today's match is 47043.
56' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
55' A pass into the box finds Jules Kounde (Barcelona) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Adrian denies him.
54' 6:5 – the total goal attempt statistics.
52' Gavi (Barcelona) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
50' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Chimy Avila (Betis) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
46' Antony (Betis) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
46' Manuel Pellegrini makes a switch. Chimy Avila (Betis) is coming on in place of Sergi Altimira at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' Jesus Manzano blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Natan (Betis) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
41' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) commits a rough challenge and Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for a foul.
39' A quickly taken corner by Barcelona.
39' A pass travels right across the box to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Adrian denies him with a decent save.

38' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is picked out by his teammate with a brilliant short pass, but it takes him too long to control the ball inside the box and this allows one of the defending players to rob him.
37' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jesus Manzano no option but to blow his whistle.
36' Adrian (Betis) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
35' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
33' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.
31' Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) was too forceful with his tackle and Jesus Manzano interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
30' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
28' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
28' Gavi (Barcelona) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
27' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
27' Antony (Betis) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
25' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Cucho Hernandez (Betis). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
23' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
22' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Jesus Manzano blows his whistle for an infringement.
20' A lofted cross from Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
19' Gavi (Barcelona) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
17' 1 - 1 The resulting corner is whipped in by Giovani Lo Celso and Natan (Betis) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top of the net. The score is 1:1.
16' Antony (Betis) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
14' A yellow card for a tackle by Natan (Betis). Jesus Manzano doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.

14' A short pass finds Cucho Hernandez (Betis). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
14' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alejandro Balde (Barcelona).
13' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
7' 1 - 0 Goal! Ferran Torres plays a pass to the feet of Gavi (Barcelona), and he shoots into the bottom left corner from inside the box. It's 1:0.
7' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

6' That didn't go as planned! Pedri (Barcelona) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the right side of the goal was too weak to get past Adrian, who easily kept it out. The ball goes out of play. Barcelona are awarded a corner kick.
4' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
3' Jules Kounde (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
